name: web-design-guidelines
title_zh: 按 Web 界面规范逐条审查你的 UI 代码
tagline_zh: 说一句「检查我的界面」，它对照 26 条业界规范逐条过你的代码，把可访问性、误触、焦点丢失这类坑连证据一起翻出来。
tagline_en: Say "review my UI" and it audits your code against 26 web interface rules, surfacing accessibility, misclicks.
desc_en: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的设计建议，而是直接读你的 HTML/CSS/JS，按规范条目逐条判定。
why_en: It reads your actual HTML/CSS/JS and checks each rule line-by-line, citing exact code locations and fixes—like a pedantic spec.
limit_zh: 只认代码文件，不认设计稿截图或 Figma 链接；只覆盖 Web Interface Guidelines 那 26 。
limit_en: Code files only—no screenshots or Figma. Covers just the 26 Web Interface Guidelines, not performance/SEO/cross-browser. Outputs an issue list, not.
